verdict.rationale: Asana is a work-management SaaS. Its AI Teammates and MCP server create, read and report on tasks and projects. Having an agent verify its own code implementation by driving an app and capturing before-and-after screenshots belongs to coding agents and browser-automation tools, so this story is a category error for Asana. Nothing in the pack shows Asana shipping app navigation or screenshot capture for agents, so the exception for a shipped wrong-axis capability does not apply.
